notes.title: Ver 1.11 Update
notes.notes:
Ver 1.11 of Machina of the Planet Tree -Unity Unions- has just been pushed to Steam. A list of updates and changes are listed below:

Ver. 1.11 Patch Notes
[list]
[*]Fixes an error where shot reload and arts cooldown stops when the minion menu is open
[*]Fixes an error where dropped staves or amulets sometimes can't be picked up
[*]Fixes an error where the confirmation button stops working after using accessing Key Configuration
[*]Fixes an error where arts will activate without their specified cooldown
[/list]
